title: Canary Analysis
description: Canary Analysis is a reliability ability in the Autonomous Patch Rollback Triggers database. Watches canary metrics and calls the deploy good or bad. Canary and baseline metrics are compared statistically; regressions beyond threshold fail the canary. It takes metrics and produces verdict. Tunable parameters: per deploy. Guarantee: verdicts always cite the failing metric.

fields.mechanism: Canary and baseline metrics are compared statistically; regressions beyond threshold fail the canary.
fields.guarantees: verdicts always cite the failing metric

title: Automatic Rollback
description: Automatic Rollback is a reliability ability in the Autonomous Patch Rollback Triggers database. Rolls back automatically when the canary fails. On failure the previous version is redeployed to the canary set within minutes. It takes failure and produces rollback. Tunable parameters: minutes. Guarantee: rollback never needs a human click.

Guarantee: deploys are never judged by gut feel.

title: Progressive Rollout

Each stage needs a clean canary analysis before the next begins. It takes stages and produces rollout. Tunable parameters: 4 stages. Guarantee: a failing stage never advances.
